preregistration.checkpoint_ceiling_correction: pre-acquisition enumeration proved that the two complete 29-point ladders produce 71 checkpoints and cannot fit the earlier 64-checkpoint ceiling; the ceiling is 72 with no adaptive checkpoints
preregistration.amendment_rule: after the first acquisition starts, any change requires a new experiment id, plan file, and provenance entry

question: Can one preregistered joint model explain and predict the observed global and per-table allocation-map transitions in three fresh Jet 3 databases?

replicas.holdout_rule: freeze the complete surviving joint model set from replicas 1 and 2 before reading replica 3; evaluate without refit, candidate addition, deletion, relaxation, or reinterpretation

row_algorithm.id: positive one-based monotonically increasing signed 32-bit integer within each logical role; deleted Id values are reinserted unchanged
row_algorithm.payload: repeat the ASCII seed A1|<role>|<Id as ten zero-padded decimal digits>| and truncate to exactly 240 characters
row_algorithm.rolling_sha256: one SHA-256 stream over each row encoded as Id signed little-endian 32-bit, Payload UTF-8 byte length unsigned little-endian 16-bit, then Payload ASCII bytes
row_algorithm.delete_rule: delete every even Id from L, preserving every odd Id so no data page is intentionally emptied
row_algorithm.reread_requirement: after every checkpoint, DAO must return the exact expected count and rolling SHA-256 for every extant table

checkpoint_design.d_growth_rule: D_GROW_0128 is the first closed-file state after a fixed 32-row batch whose page count is at least the post-create D baseline plus 128; record overshoot and do not retune
checkpoint_design.relative_growth_rule: each L_REL or H_REL checkpoint is the first closed-file state after a fixed 32-row batch whose page count is at least that table's post-create baseline plus the named target; record overshoot and do not retune
checkpoint_design.absolute_growth_rule: each P_ABS checkpoint is the first closed-file state after a fixed 32-row batch whose total file page count is at least the named target; record overshoot and do not retune

page_capture.checkpoint_representation: ordered physical-page SHA-256 values from page zero through the final page

page_one: exactly one caller-delimited allocation-map record has a unique observed start and end on physical page 1
D allocation, drop, and recreate/regrow exhibit an allocate-free-reallocate ABA transition
the same record tracks both L and H growth
hypotheses.negative_page_candidate_space: every observed physical page other than page 1 must be evaluated and rejected by the same transition predicates; page 1 is not privileged after acquisition
hypotheses.tdef_pointer_rule: enumerate every four-byte offset in the uniquely delimited record under exactly both layouts; used and free offsets must be distinct and distinguished by growth versus alternating delete/reinsert transitions
hypotheses.inline_extent_rule: one exact record boundary must agree across derivation replicas and used/free observations, explain every final inline bit and the inline-to-indirect conversion, and have an all-zero suffix; ambiguity or an unexplained nonzero suffix produces no outcome
hypotheses.type1_rule: inactive four-byte slots are exactly zero in the observed record; active references identify observed pages whose byte-zero tag is 0x05; L uses the low observed slot and H uses the next observed slot
hypotheses.extended_base_rule: derive only from preregistered allocation transitions; no candidate formula may be added after acquisition

decision_rules.decisive: exactly one complete joint model survives every derivation transition in replicas 1 and 2 and, without refit, predicts every applicable holdout transition in replica 3
no_scientific_outcome: zero or more than one surviving joint model
